francesco antonio.bio: Francesco Antonio is a Toronto-born actor, recording artist, writer and director whose music career developed alongside his film and television work. After meeting Canadian reggae artist Snow in a Toronto studio, he joined Snow's DKO Music Group and became part of the label's emerging artist roster. His appearance on Snow's 2020 single Together with William Dinero and Balam Kiel is his Northern Dial library credit.

soft eyez.bio: Soft Eyez is a producer and recording artist associated with London, Ontario hip-hop collective 4DaTribe. He has released solo instrumental work and built an extensive collaborative catalogue with KOTO?, including Mornington Me and the 4DaTribe Disc projects. DerekFisher, recorded with KOTO? and chai sully, is his Northern Dial library credit.

jesse mcmillan.bio: Jesse McMillan is a Saskatoon drummer active in the city's jazz, neo-soul and alternative scenes. He has performed with vbnd's Soulmate Collective and with Saskatoon post-punk band Hollow Oax, appearing throughout vbnd's Scum Funk recordings. His drums on vbnd's 2019 single No Other Feeling with Katie Tupper and Connor Newton account for his Northern Dial library credit.

wolfy lights.bio: Wolfy Lights is the electronic and drum-and-bass project of Sherry St. Germain, a classically trained multi-instrumentalist, producer, singer and songwriter with Toronto roots. St. Germain has also worked under the AKYLLA name and has collaborated with artists across electronic, hip-hop, film and television music. Bombalaya, its Blooom remix and Born Again are the three Wolfy Lights tracks in the Northern Dial library.

twotwo.bio: TWOTWO is a Toronto rapper associated with More Real Entertainment and the city's street-rap scene. He broke through alongside Pengz on the 2017 Toronto hit Griselda Blanco before releasing solo tracks including Ball and Wrist and later reuniting with Pengz for Gangsta. Griselda Blanco is his Northern Dial library credit.
